plotSections.title: Evening at the Stronghold
bullets: The session opens one day after the party regrouped following their forest endeavor with Ord's magic and the light-bringer staff; it is early evening at the Langdale Stronghold.
Mahali is in the kitchen/dining room preparing the evening meal, originally a pork roast that he decides to turn into a stew because the pork flank is too tough.
Ord confirms he gave the staff/lantern to Sylan, who wanted to do something with it.

Walker sits at the kitchen's small plating station and abruptly asks Mahali whether he became a god or was born one; Mahali calls it a long question and first wants tea started and help with dinner prep.
Mahali has been teaching Ponchi to cook in the interim; Ponchi likes it, but gems sometimes turn up in his buns, the largest reportedly thumb-sized, which Mahali threw out the window.
Mahali asks for Ponchi to dice onions and says Ponchi's roommate should fetch him; Ponchi's roommate is Ord, who sleeps in the bunkhouse below.
Walker prepares to yell across the stronghold for Ord; Ord's full name is given as Ord Brontan, with no middle name.

chronologicalEvents: 1. One day after regrouping from the forest endeavor, the party is at the stronghold in the evening while Mahali cooks.
2. Ord confirms Sylan now holds the staff/lantern.
3. Walker sits at the kitchen plating station and asks Mahali if he became a god or was born one.
4. Mahali defers, mentions tea, and explains he has been teaching Ponchi to cook (gems sometimes appear in Ponchi's buns).
5. Mahali decides the tough pork flank will become a stew and wants Ponchi to chop onions.
6. Mahali says Ponchi's roommate Ord should fetch him; Walker prepares to shout for Ord, whose surname is Brontan.

Mahali.existing: Elder god serving as the party's chef at the stronghold.
notes: Preparing the evening meal; turning a tough pork flank into a stew instead of a roast.
Has been teaching Ponchi to cook.
Asked by Walker whether he became a god or was born one; called it a very long question and had not yet answered by the end of this chunk.
Threw a thumb-sized gem found in one of Ponchi's buns out the window.
personality: Hospitable and fussy about proper process, wanting tea before a serious conversation.
Deflects abrupt personal questions with domestic tasks.
quotesThemes: "We haven't even had any tea yet."
openQuestions: Did Mahali become a god, or was he born one?

Ponchi.existing: Stronghold guard who relocated to the tavern.
notes: Being taught to cook by Mahali and seems to enjoy it.
Gems sometimes turn up in the buns he bakes, the largest about thumb-sized.
Rooms with Ord in the bunkhouse below the stronghold.
Full name is Ord Brontan; has no middle name.
Sleeps in the bunkhouse below and is Ponchi's roommate.
Now holds the fused lantern-staff, given to him by Ord, and intends to do something with it.
Asked Mahali whether he became a god or was born one.
Asked whether there were freshly baked buns and was interested in how much the gems in Ponchi's buns are worth.

Fused lantern-staff.existing: Fused lantern and staff that reveals the Ethereal Plane.
notes: Referred to as the staff with the light bringer.

misTranscriptions.notes: Ord's surname, as stated by Ord's player.

openQuestions: Did Mahali become a god, or was he born one?
